column4: SELECT    o.id, o.tenant_id, o.restaurant_id, o.order_number, o.customer_name, o.customer_email,    o.customer_phone, o.delivery_address, o.delivery_city, o.delivery_area,    o.delivery_zip_code, o.delivery_latitude, o.delivery_longitude,    o.delivery_instructions, o.subtotal, o.tax_amount, o.discount_amount,    o.delivery_fee, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.payment_status,    o.status, o.estimated_delivery_time, o.actual_delivery_time, o.notes, o.order_source,    o.table_id, t.table_number, COALESCE(t.name, $4), COALESCE(t.location, $5), t.capacity,    o.created_at, o.updated_at   FROM orders o   LEFT JOIN restaurant_tables t    ON t.id = o.table_id    AND t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id    AND t.restaurant_id = o.restaurant_id   WHERE o.id = $1 AND o.tenant_id = $2 AND o.restaurant_id = $3

SELECT    id, order_id, product_id, variant_id, product_name, variant_name,    quantity, unit_price, discount_amount, total_price,    special_instructions, addons, created_at, updated_at   FROM order_items   WHERE order_id = $1   ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.tenant_id, r.role_name, COALESCE(r.description, $3), r.role_code, r.is_system_role, r.created_at, r.updated_at   FROM user_roles ur   JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id   WHERE ur.user_id = $1 AND ur.tenant_id = $2 AND r.is_active = $4   ORDER BY r.is_system_role DESC, r.role_name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT    o.id, o.tenant_id, o.restaurant_id, o.order_number, o.customer_name, o.customer_email,    o.customer_phone, o.subtotal, o.tax_amount, o.discount_amount, o.delivery_fee,    o.total_amount, o.payment_status, o.status, o.order_source, o.table_id,    t.table_number, COALESCE(t.name, $5), COALESCE(t.location, $6), t.capacity,    o.created_at, o.updated_at     FROM orders o   LEFT JOIN restaurant_tables t     ON t.id = o.table_id    AND t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id    AND t.restaurant_id = o.restaurant_id     WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 AND o.restaurant_id = $2   ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)    FROM orders o   LEFT JOIN restaurant_tables t     ON t.id = o.table_id    AND t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id    AND t.restaurant_id = o.restaurant_id     WHERE o.tenant_id = $1 AND o.restaurant_id = $2
SELECT permission_level   FROM role_permissions   WHERE role_id = $1 AND module_id = $2
